visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Three Reversals Instead of k Single Steps
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The array is rotated one step at a time, k times, shifting every element on every step. Rotate with three reversals. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Shifting one step at a time takes n times k moves. Three reversals take about 2n moves no matter how large k is, and need no extra array.
